https://deepmind.google/blog/powering-th.extra_title_fact: Google DeepMind's accelerator selected 15 European robotics companies for three months of mentorship and technical support.

https://deepmind.google/blog/measuring-t.title: Measuring the impact of learning with AI in Sierra Leone and beyond

https://mistral.ai/news/ai-now-summit-20.title: AI Now Summit 2026

https://mistral.ai/news/vibe-agent.title: Vibe gets to work.
https://mistral.ai/news/vibe-agent.extra_title_fact: Mistral Vibe runs long tasks such as inbox management, research, and document drafting in Work Mode, alongside Code Mode for coding.

https://mistral.ai/news/search-toolkit.title: Introducing Search Toolkit
https://mistral.ai/news/search-toolkit.extra_title_fact: Search Toolkit is an open-source public-preview framework that combines ingestion, retrieval, and evaluation under one interface.

https://mistral.ai/news/introducing-phys.title: Introducing physics AI at Mistral: the foundation for engineering acceleration.
https://mistral.ai/news/introducing-phys.extra_title_fact: Mistral's physics AI work targets engineering simulations and live operational data, with ASML, Airbus, Safran, and Siemens Energy cited as partners.

https://mistral.ai/news/physics-ai-resea.title: Physics AI research that’s shaping the industry.
https://mistral.ai/news/physics-ai-resea.extra_title_fact: Emmi AI is now part of Mistral, and its research models physical systems for engineering work.

https://mistral.ai/news/accelerate-ai-na.title: Emmi joins Mistral to accelerate the AI-native industry
https://mistral.ai/news/accelerate-ai-na.extra_title_fact: Mistral agreed to acquire Emmi AI to add physics modeling and engineering-tool support to its industrial AI products.

https://mistral.ai/news/vibe-remote-agen.title: Remote agents in Vibe. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5.
https://mistral.ai/news/vibe-remote-agen.extra_title_fact: Mistral Medium 3.5 is a 128B open-weight model powering cloud remote agents, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.

https://mistral.ai/news/connectors.title: Connect the dots: Build with built-in and custom MCPs in Studio
https://mistral.ai/news/connectors.extra_title_fact: Studio Connectors are available through the API and SDK, with direct tool calls and human approval flows for built-in and custom MCPs.

https://deepmind.google/blog/were-launch.title: We’re launching the Google DeepMind Accelerator program in Asia Pacific to tackle environmental risks
https://deepmind.google/blog/were-launch.extra_title_fact: Google DeepMind's three-month APAC accelerator offers selected startups, research teams, and nonprofits mentorship and model-integration support for environmental projects.

https://deepmind.google/blog/fast-tracki.title: Fast-tracking genetic leads to reverse cellular aging
https://deepmind.google/blog/fast-tracki.extra_title_fact: Researchers use Co-Scientist to rank gene pathways that may move cells away from senescence in aging studies.

https://deepmind.google/blog/simulate-re.title: Simulate real-world places with Project Genie and Street View
https://deepmind.google/blog/simulate-re.extra_title_fact: Project Genie now pairs interactive world generation with nearly 20 years of Street View imagery and is available to Google AI Ultra subscribers.

https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.title: Introducing Gemini Omni
https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.extra_title_fact: Gemini Omni Flash generates video from varied inputs and supports conversational editing.

https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.title: Introducing Google Antigravity 2.0
https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.extra_title_fact: Antigravity 2.0 is a standalone desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows that runs synchronous or asynchronous agents without an IDE.

https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-for-.title: Gemini for Science: AI experiments and tools for a new era of discovery
https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-for-.extra_title_fact: Google's Science Skills and three Google Labs tools apply Co-Scientist, AlphaEvolve, and NotebookLM to steps in the scientific method.

https://deepmind.google/blog/making-it-e.title: Making it easier to understand how content was created and edited
https://deepmind.google/blog/making-it-e.extra_title_fact: Google says SynthID has watermarked more than 100 billion images and videos and 60,000 years of audio, with verification tools expanding across Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel, and Cloud.

https://deepmind.google/blog/strengtheni.title: Strengthening Singapore’s AI Future: A New National Partnership
https://deepmind.google/blog/strengtheni.extra_title_fact: Google DeepMind's Singapore partnership targets health and life sciences, classrooms, and workforce programs through national AI initiatives.

https://deepmind.google/blog/finding-the.title: Finding the molecular switches behind new infectious diseases
https://deepmind.google/blog/finding-the.extra_title_fact: Cambridge researcher Clare Bryant uses Co-Scientist to generate and rank hypotheses about molecular switches involved in severe infection.

https://mistral.ai/news/workflows.title: Workflows for work that runs the business
https://mistral.ai/news/workflows.extra_title_fact: Mistral Workflows is in public preview and adds durable execution, observability, and fault tolerance for long-running enterprise AI processes.

https://mistral.ai/news/spaces.title: Spaces: A CLI Built for Humans and Agents
https://mistral.ai/news/spaces.extra_title_fact: Mistral Spaces scaffolds project directories, configuration files, connected services, and staging deployment from a CLI.

https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-tts.title: Speaking of Voxtral
https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-tts.extra_title_fact: Voxtral TTS is a 4B-parameter model for nine languages, available through API and Mistral Studio at $0.016 per 1,000 characters.

https://mistral.ai/news/forge.title: Introducing Forge
https://mistral.ai/news/forge.extra_title_fact: Forge lets enterprises build models grounded in proprietary knowledge and internal processes while keeping data in their own environments.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-small-4.title: Introducing Mistral Small 4
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-small-4.extra_title_fact: Mistral Small 4 unifies reasoning, multimodal input, and agentic coding in one Apache 2.0 model.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ai-and-n.title: Mistral AI partners with NVIDIA to accelerate open frontier models
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ai-and-n.extra_title_fact: Mistral joined NVIDIA's Nemotron Coalition and released Mistral Small 4 under Apache 2.0 for open development.

https://mistral.ai/news/leanstral.title: Leanstral: Open-Source foundation for trustworthy vibe-coding
https://mistral.ai/news/leanstral.extra_title_fact: Leanstral is an open model for Lean 4 proof engineering designed to let agents check code against formal specifications before human review.

https://mistral.ai/news/rails-testing-on.title: Rails testing on autopilot: Building an agent that writes what developers won't
https://mistral.ai/news/rails-testing-on.extra_title_fact: Mistral's Rails agent reads models, serializers, controllers, mailers, and helpers to generate or improve RSpec tests in parallel inside CI/CD.

https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-transcri.title: Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound.
https://mistral.ai/news/voxtral-transcri.extra_title_fact: Voxtral Transcribe 2 includes Mini for batch transcription and Realtime for live use, with the latter released as Apache 2.0 open weights.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-vibe-2-0.title: Terminally online Mistral Vibe.
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-vibe-2-0.extra_title_fact: Mistral Vibe 2.0 adds custom subagents, slash-command skills, and clarify-before-execute controls, and is available on Le Chat Pro and Team.

https://mistral.ai/news/debugging-memory.title: Heaps do lie: debugging a memory leak in vLLM.
https://mistral.ai/news/debugging-memory.extra_title_fact: Mistral traced a vLLM leak to graph compilation with Mistral Medium 3.1, where production-like traffic increased memory by about 400 MB per minute.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ocr-3.title: Introducing Mistral OCR 3
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ocr-3.extra_title_fact: Mistral OCR 3 recorded a 74% overall win rate against OCR 2 on forms, scans, complex tables, and handwriting.

https://mistral.ai/news/devstral-2-vibe-.title: Introducing: Devstral 2 and Mistral Vibe CLI.
https://mistral.ai/news/devstral-2-vibe-.extra_title_fact: Devstral 2 comes in 123B and Devstral Small 2 in 24B, with modified MIT and Apache 2.0 licenses respectively.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-3.title: Introducing Mistral 3
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-3.extra_title_fact: Mistral 3 combines 14B, 8B, and 3B dense models with Mistral Large 3, a 41B-active, 675B-total-parameter mixture of experts, all under Apache 2.0.

https://mistral.ai/news/ki-fur-deutschla.title: Mistral AI - KI für Deutschland
https://mistral.ai/news/ki-fur-deutschla.extra_title_fact: Mistral and SAP are building a multiyear sovereign AI stack for Germany and Europe, with models integrated into SAP's AI Foundation.

https://mistral.ai/news/ai-studio.title: Introducing Mistral AI Studio.
https://mistral.ai/news/ai-studio.extra_title_fact: Mistral AI Studio includes an AI Registry that tracks lineage, ownership, and versioning for agents, models, datasets, tools, and workflows.

https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ai-raise.title: Mistral AI raises 1.7B€ to accelerate technological progress with AI
https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-ai-raise.extra_title_fact: Mistral raised €1.7 billion in Series C at an €11.7 billion post-money valuation, led by ASML.

https://mistral.ai/news/memory.title: Make Memory work for you.
https://mistral.ai/news/memory.extra_title_fact: Mistral's Memories beta uses a graph-based architecture and lets users inspect and control what the assistant remembers.

https://mistral.ai/news/le-chat-mcp-conn.title: Le Chat. Custom MCP connectors. Memories.
https://mistral.ai/news/le-chat-mcp-conn.extra_title_fact: Le Chat's beta connector directory lists more than 20 integrations, including Databricks, GitHub, Atlassian, Asana, Outlook, Box, Stripe, and Zapier.

https://mistral.ai/news/unlocking-potent.title: Unlocking the potential of vision language models on satellite imagery through fine-tuning
